Plans For New Hotel, Retail Store & 54 Homes On Shannon Shamrock Site

16 November 2026
Share
Facebook
X
WhatsApp
Linkedin
Email
Print
    NewsCurrent Affairs
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 1:06
    Instaread

    Plans have been lodged for a new hotel, a major housing development and a retail store in one of Clare’s most popular tourist destinations.

    It comes just over a year after controversial proposals for a housing estate to be built at the site were refused.

    - Advertisement -

    Last May, Crescent House Limited’s application for a 67 unit-housing development on the grounds of the former Shannon Shamrock Hotel were rejected by An Coimisúin Pleanála.

    The Commission overturned the ruling of Clare County Council and its own inspector in the process, arguing the move could have significant negative impacts on Bunratty tourism and the visual amenity of the area.

    A number of public submissions called strongly for additional bed night spaces and those prayers have potentially been answered with a new proposal now on the table.

    Voyage Property LTD is now looking to build an 80-bed Hotel, 54 homes, consisting of two and three-bed properties and a convenience retail store.

    The development is mooted for a 3.6 hectare site and 211 new parking spaces are proposed.

    The local authority is accepting submissions until December 15th.
